purpose: Authoritative non-secret registry of external capabilities available to Parma agents. Secrets and refresh tokens must never be stored here.
operating_rule: Agents consume named capabilities through the Parma backend/control tower; Philippe is required only for provider-enforced human authorization, security/payment recovery, or RED mutations.

connections.human_gate: Only for permissions outside connector scope or protected/irreversible operations
OAuth/security recovery and any campaign/spend mutation not already delegated
OAuth/security recovery and tracking/configuration mutations outside delegated scope

connections.blocker: Direct Wix connector invocation is currently disabled in the active tool environment; autonomous backend credential/API path still needs materialization.
connections.human_gate: Only one-time provider OAuth/API authorization if required once a supported direct path is available; no repeated manual data relay
Provider security/payment checkpoint and any activation/spend mutation

connections.blocker: Routine direct read access is verified. Remaining work is capability materialization for shared agents and validation of additional read surfaces; mutations remain independently gated.
connections.human_gate: Only provider-enforced security/credential recovery or operations outside the delegated GREEN/YELLOW envelope

agent_rules: Never expose provider credentials to agents or shared state
Return capability names and health, not secrets
Read-only capabilities may be GREEN when already authorized
Writes must preserve independent permission classes
Provider re-authentication must become a durable blocker rather than a chat relay loop
All connection failures must identify the smallest human action actually required
